title: Ultra Hello World
content:
This example demonstrates the absolute minimal footprint of Photon. By avoiding middleware on specific routes, Photon engages its MinimalContext optimization automatically.

Optimal Implementation

import { Gravito } from '@gravito/core/engine'

const app = new Gravito()

// Pure static route uses MinimalContext internally
app.get('/ping', (c) => {
  return c.text('pong')
})

export default {
  fetch: app.fetch.bind(app)
}

Lab Note: The engine automatically detects "Pure Static" routes (no middleware, no params) and bypasses the standard Context pool for zero-allocation dispatch.
